title: Micron Technology Q2 FY2026 Earnings
thesisImpact: Micron reports memory chip revenue and demand trends relevant to datacenter and AI server buildouts. HBM (high-bandwidth memory) shipment volumes indicate GPU production pace.

title: Constellation Energy Q1 2026 Earnings
thesisImpact: Constellation operates the largest US nuclear fleet. Earnings include updates on the Three Mile Island Unit 1 restart process and any new datacenter power purchase agreements.

title: NRC Palisades Nuclear Restart Review
thesisImpact: NRC review of Holtec's application to restart the 800 MW Palisades plant in Michigan. If approved, it would be the first US nuclear plant restarted from decommissioned status.

title: Eaton Corporation Q1 2026 Earnings
thesisImpact: Eaton's electrical segment reports order intake for switchgear, power distribution units, and transformer systems used in datacenter construction. Backlog levels reflect infrastructure demand.

title: GE Vernova Q1 2026 Earnings
thesisImpact: GE Vernova reports on gas turbine orders, grid equipment backlog, and transformer lead times. Order book data reflects utility-scale power infrastructure spending levels.

title: Meta and Microsoft Q1 2026 Earnings
thesisImpact: Meta and Microsoft report quarterly capital expenditure figures for AI infrastructure and datacenter expansion. Capex guidance updates indicate downstream demand for power and cooling equipment.

title: PJM Capacity Auction Results
thesisImpact: PJM Interconnection holds annual capacity auctions for its 13-state service territory. Clearing prices determine forward revenue for generators and reflect supply-demand balance on the largest US grid.

title: Vertiv Holdings Q1 2026 Earnings
thesisImpact: Vertiv supplies thermal management and power infrastructure for datacenters. Order growth and backlog figures reflect datacenter construction activity and cooling demand for high-density AI racks.

title: NVIDIA Q1 FY2027 Earnings
thesisImpact: NVIDIA reports datacenter GPU revenue and forward guidance. Shipment volumes and next-generation product ramp timelines affect downstream power and cooling infrastructure procurement.

title: FERC Order 1920 Implementation
thesisImpact: FERC Order 1920 (issued May 2024) requires regional transmission organizations to conduct 20-year forward-looking planning. Compliance filings and planning studies are ongoing through 2026.

title: DOE Loan Programs Office Disbursements
thesisImpact: The DOE Loan Programs Office has authority to issue loans and loan guarantees for nuclear, grid, and clean energy projects. Disbursement decisions affect project financing timelines.

title: Large Power Transformer Trade Policy Review
thesisImpact: US trade policy on large power transformer imports affects domestic supply availability. The US imports a significant share of LPTs, and tariff changes impact grid equipment procurement timelines.

title: Three Mile Island Unit 1 Restart Progress
thesisImpact: Constellation Energy is pursuing restart of TMI Unit 1 (837 MW) under a power purchase agreement with Microsoft. NRC review and regulatory approvals are required before restart operations can begin.
